# Sololearn

> Sololearn is a free interactive platform for learning coding and AI skills through hands-on courses, a multi-language compiler playground, and community discussions.

Sololearn offers comprehensive coding education covering fundamental programming languages (Python, Java, JavaScript, C++, HTML, CSS) alongside cutting-edge AI and machine learning courses. The platform combines self-paced interactive lessons with practical tools like an online code editor and collaborative community features, making it accessible to beginners and professionals seeking skill development.

## Key Topics

- Python
- AI/Machine Learning
- JavaScript
- Java
- HTML/CSS
- C++
- Coding Courses
- Interactive Learning
- Data Analysis
- Generative AI
- Online Code Editor
- Free Platform
- Skill Development
- Certification
- Community Q&A

## Core Learning Platform

- [Sololearn Homepage](https://www.sololearn.com/pl): Main platform entry point offering coding courses in Python, AI, ML and more for learners of all levels
- [Compiler Playground & Code Editor](https://www.sololearn.com/pl/compiler-playground): Free online code editor and compiler supporting 15+ programming languages including Python, Java, HTML, CSS, C++, and JavaScript

## AI & Advanced Topics

- [Generative AI in Practice](https://www.sololearn.com/pl/learn/courses/genai-in-practice): Practical course on generative AI tools including DALL-E, Midjourney, and prompt engineering techniques
- [Data Analysis with AI](https://www.sololearn.com/pl/learn/courses/data-ai): Data analysis course integrating AI tools for data visualization, insights generation, and analytical workflows
- [Social Media Marketing with AI](https://www.sololearn.com/pl/learn/courses/sm-ai): Learn AI-powered social media marketing strategies for content creation and audience engagement
- [Creative Thinking with AI](https://www.sololearn.com/pl/learn/courses/creativity-ai): Course on leveraging AI tools for creative idea generation, inspiration, and innovative thinking

## Community & Enterprise Solutions

- [Community Q&A Discussions](https://www.sololearn.com/pl/discuss): Interactive community forum for asking questions, discussing coding challenges, and peer learning
- [Sololearn Teams](https://www.sololearn.com/pl/teams): Corporate training platform enabling businesses to upskill employees through interactive tech and coding courses
